verdict.rationale: Conductor originally required full read/write GitHub access, which the community sharply criticized as far from least-privilege; the vendor later added fine-grained GitHub repository access (or the option to skip the integration and use local GitHub CLI auth) as a fix. This shows scoped credentialing exists but only as a community-driven remediation, not a documented, first-party 'scoped API credentials' feature for agents. Missing for 10: official docs describing least-privilege/scoped credential issuance, evidence this applies to the Conductor API/MCP server itself (not just GitHub OAuth), and independent confirmation the fine-grained permissions are robust.
